decisions.detail: Script: name tokens with an alias map (Dillman/CEI/JCI/KPI/Telsmith/Roadtec->Astec, Clark/Melroe/Doosan->Bobcat, Sweepster/JRB->Paladin, Joy->Komatsu, Bucyrus->Caterpillar, Dredging Supply->DSC, Pileco/GEFCO->Bauer) + state + city, plus an address pass (street number + first street word, city ignored), against ledger/plants.csv and the unmerged closure-1, 2A and 2B inbox plants. 23 script candidate pairs not accepted as written (rejected by eye, e.g. City of Des Moines -> Eagle Iron Works, Progress Rail -> East Attachments, Manitowoc Cranes -> Wisconsin Heavy Fabrication; or re-pointed, e.g. Deere 1000 John Deere Rd; or turned into second-site leads, GOMACO Plant 2 and Roadtec Riverside Dr). 2 matched by hand beyond the script (Best Equipment Poplarville, BOONE TRAIL Sanford). 18 rows are dual-coded with closure-1's ECHO 333131 table and their decisions were reused.

skip = distributors/dealers/rental, contractors, ready-mix and aggregate producers, portable/temporary permits, public bodies, lifting (cranes, AWPs, telehandlers, forks, utility trucks), on-road truck bodies/mixers/snowplows, trailers, undercarriage/winch/filter/cylinder/engine component makers, rail, remanufacturing, test sites and offices, registrations of non-target or unknown firms last inspected long ago (stale; 12 rows, e.g. 1985-1999 inspections). A pre-2017 inspection alone did not skip a plausible in-definition maker: those stay unverified (e.g. Grasan 2016, Allied 2015, Barko 2005). new base needs a current source that the site operates and manufactures; an ECHO row alone never sets base. unverified is split: 17 table rows researched (15 entities, all in top-level unverified; 4 of them researched by earlier passes and not repeated) and 102 rows triaged by name/NAICS only (not attempted).

decisions.item: Relationship and tier for the new base plants
decisions.detail: Asphalt plants, pavers, road-maintenance machines, concrete pumps and batch plants follow the Astec Chattanooga / CWMF / Rexcon / LeeBoy precedent (OEM, new). None sells attachments, buckets, bodies or tanks for mining machines or builds crushers/screens/conveyors/feeders.

FY2025 10-K property table: Marquette IA (owned offices and manufacturing), Orlando FL (owned corporate offices and manufacturing), Chambersburg PA (leased offices and manufacturing). Chambersburg street address and Blaw-Knox paver product are inferred from the EPA facility name. The company board's Welder posting names no site and is undated: listed, not counted.

Wood/organics grinders and forestry machines (Morbark Winn, Bandit Remus, TimberPro Shawano, Barko Superior, Brown Bear, Wildcat, DZ Grinders, Cutting Systems, Jarraff, Allied Systems) are boundary under consultation 9 and were left for a later pass rather than researched here.
